dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged perimeters of high-luminance 'O' and 'C' shaped structures; the gradient transitions sharply from the light-colored outer ring to a lower-intensity dark center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of low-intensity pixel clusters localized within the centers of the light annuli; larger, asymmetrical solid dark patches are concentrated in the lower posterior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent light-ring structures in the dorsal-mid region form a non-equilateral pentagonal arrangement; the three most anterior rings form a right-leaning triangle.
